findings.title: Unlimited USDC approval to Uniswap V3 SwapRouter
findings.detail: USDC allowance is 2^256-1 (unlimited) for spender 0xE592427A0AEce92De3Edee1F18E0157C05861564 (Uniswap V3 SwapRouter). That contract can move ALL of your USDC at any time, now and in the future.
findings.recommendation: Revoke or cap this approval (e.g. revoke.cash or Etherscan Token Approvals) unless you actively use this spender every day.

findings.title: WETH approved to an unrecognised spender
findings.detail: Spender 0x5aAeb6053F3E94C9b9A09f33669435E7Ef1BeAed is not on the known-protocol list and holds an allowance of 1 WETH. Unknown spenders are the classic approval-phishing / drainer pattern.
findings.recommendation: Verify what this spender is before using it again; revoke if you do not recognise it.
